title: wg: protocol-06 §5.9 AbuseReport optional/UTF-8 fields
description: Suggestion/erratum. §5.9 calls reportingUser optional but types it bare IdentifierUri (mimid treats empty as absent, mimid-1wgh.5.59); calls note UTF-8 but types it opaque<V> (mimid-1wgh.5.60).
